pool.manager_golf_einladung.titel: An invitation to the golf course
pool.manager_golf_einladung.e.e1: The board is playing a round this weekend, and we would love to have you along.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.e.e2: A few gentlemen from the supervisory board are meeting on the course. Join us, many things are easier to discuss there than in the office.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.e.e3: The course is booked and the coffee ordered. Only the manager is missing.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.e.e4: Not every question belongs in a meeting. Play a round with us and we will talk it over in peace.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.e.e5: Some on the board only know you from the papers. A round of golf would change that.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.e.e6: We have put your name down in case you feel like it. You can cancel any time, but it would be nice.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.a.a1: Gladly, I am looking forward to the round and to a chat away from the daily grind.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.a.a2: I will come along. For me this is part of the job, because it is how people get to know each other.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.a.a3: My assistant can cover the date, I will drop by for a coffee later.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.a.a4: I am in, but the loser pays for dinner, and I do not play badly.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.a.a5: Who else is coming? That decides what we can talk about.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.a.a6: I will gladly come, and while we are at it we can talk about the budget.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.a.a7: Thank you, but I stay with the team at the weekend. Golf is not my business.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.a.a8: My schedule is set and I am not cancelling. Whoever wants to talk to me can come to the training ground.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.r.r1: {b.gut} That really pleases us, that is how it should be.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.r.r2: {b.gut} Excellent, we are curious about your ideas.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.r.r3: {b.gut} Good, then we will make a pleasant day of it.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.r.r4: {b.neutral} We will see what comes of it.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.r.r5: {b.neutral} Fine, we will plan both with you and without you.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.r.r6: {b.neutral} Then we will take it as it comes.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.r.r7: {b.schlecht} That is a pity, we had hoped for more.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.r.r8: {b.schlecht} This is not how we come together, and the house notices.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.r.r9: {b.schlecht} I would not have expected that, after everything we do for you.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.x.x1: The round was a win: the board knows you better now, and {name} has all the threads in hand.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.x.x2: The invitation stays open, {name} will get in touch at the next chance.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.x.x3: The board is talking about you keeping your distance. {name} is annoyed.
pool.manager_golf_einladung.x.x4: You declined, and {name} takes note of it without another word.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.e.e1: We invite you to a dinner with our guests on Friday. People would love to meet you.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.e.e2: Our managing director is hosting a small reception and hopes you will accept.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.e.e3: As part of the partnership we are holding a dinner. Your seat at the table is reserved.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.e.e4: Some of our most important customers are fans of the club. A word from you would mean a lot to them.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.e.e5: We would be glad if you spent the evening with us, with no suit and tie required.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.e.e6: There will be good food and little talk. Come if the fixtures allow it.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.a.a1: Gladly, thank you for the invitation. I will come and bring some time with me.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.a.a2: I accept, because a partnership lives from getting to know each other, and this is part of it.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.a.a3: I will send my press officer, but I will drop by briefly later.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.a.a4: If there is a good steak on offer, I am in at once.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.a.a5: Who will sit next to me? I want to know what I must prepare for.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.a.a6: I will gladly come, and I will use the chance to talk about the shirt advertising.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.a.a7: Thank you, but I keep work and dinner apart. Please understand.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.a.a8: I am not coming. A dinner does not replace points, and they matter more now.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.r.r1: {b.gut} We are delighted, it will be a lovely evening.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.r.r2: {b.gut} Wonderful, the guests will be thrilled.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.r.r3: {b.gut} Very good, then the partnership stays alive.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.r.r4: {b.neutral} We will let you know how the evening will run.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.r.r5: {b.neutral} All right, we will plan flexibly.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.r.r6: {b.neutral} We will take that as it is.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.r.r7: {b.schlecht} We regret that, we had expected more from it.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.r.r8: {b.schlecht} An attitude like that gets around the company.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.r.r9: {b.schlecht} You disappoint us there, and we say so honestly.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.x.x1: The evening was a success, and {name} praises it around the company.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.x.x2: {name} leaves the door open and invites you to the next occasion.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.x.x3: {name} has the impression that the club does not matter to the sponsor.
pool.manager_sponsor_dinner.x.x4: {name} accepts the refusal and plans without you.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.e.e1: The association is offering new courses. We would welcome you going for further training.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.e.e2: The competition regularly sends its managers to seminars. It should be no different with us.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.e.e3: The board suggested you go for further training. The club bears part of the cost.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.e.e4: Whoever learns stays ahead. Choose a course that fits your weaknesses.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.e.e5: There are voices who wish you more knowledge. That is no reproach, only a hint.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.e.e6: A course in winter would be ideal, while there are fewer games.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.a.a1: A good idea, I will pick a course and sign up.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.a.a2: I am happy to train further, because football changes quickly and I want to keep up.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.a.a3: My assistant will check which course fits, and I will decide afterwards.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.a.a4: Gladly, if the club bears the cost I will book two straight away.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.a.a5: Which topics do you consider necessary? I want to know where the shoe pinches.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.a.a6: I will sign up and expect more room in planning in return.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.a.a7: Thank you, but I learn more on the pitch than in a seminar room.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.a.a8: If you do not trust me, say so openly. I am not going on a course just because I am told to.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.r.r1: {b.gut} That is a smart step, we will support you.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.r.r2: {b.gut} Very good, that is how you grow stronger.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.r.r3: {b.gut} We are very much in agreement.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.r.r4: {b.neutral} We will leave it at that for now.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.r.r5: {b.neutral} We will talk about it again in spring.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.r.r7: {b.schlecht} That meets with a lack of understanding on our side.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.r.r8: {b.schlecht} Whoever does not want to learn should not wonder when others pass by.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.r.r9: {b.schlecht} We take note of that, and it will not go without consequences.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.x.x1: The board is satisfied, and {name} sees you on a good path.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.x.x2: {name} lets the matter rest until the fixtures allow it.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.x.x3: On the board they say you are unwilling to learn. {name} worries about the cooperation.
pool.manager_lehrgang_empfehlung.x.x4: {name} drops the matter without further comment.
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.e.e1: You were on holiday while the team keeps losing. How do you explain that to the fans?
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.e.e2: There are photos of you on the beach. The club is in a crisis, can you understand the criticism?
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.e.e3: Some supporters call your holiday an insolence. What do you say to that?
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.e.e4: A manager has to be there in bad times. Were you?
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.e.e5: Your assistant looked after the team. Does that feel like leadership?
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.e.e6: We hear you treated yourself to some rest. Will you also give the team a step forward?
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.a.a1: I was rested and I am back with new energy. That helps the team more than a tired manager.
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.a.a2: The holiday was planned long ago and fell in a break from fixtures. The work carried on.
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.a.a3: The club will comment on that, I stay with the sporting side.
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.a.a4: Of course I see the criticism, and I take it seriously. We are working on it together.
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.a.a5: What makes you ask that? I am curious where you heard it.
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.a.a6: Said with a smile: managers have a right to some sun too. Next week there will be three points for it.
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.a.a7: My private life is none of your business. Ask me about the game.
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.a.a8: Whoever accuses me of laziness has never watched us. That question is insulting.
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.r.r1: {b.gut} That was an honest answer, and the fans will respect it.
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.r.r2: {b.gut} You came across as matter-of-fact, which goes down well.
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.r.r3: {b.gut} The cameras show a composed manager, which soothes.
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.r.r4: {b.neutral} The answer will be read in different ways in the papers.
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.r.r5: {b.neutral} It will be written down, and nothing more happens for now.
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.r.r6: {b.neutral} That was neither good nor bad, the debate goes on.
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.r.r7: {b.schlecht} The answer sounds evasive, and the press keeps at it.
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.r.r8: {b.schlecht} That came across as arrogant, and the headlines will say so.
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.r.r9: {b.schlecht} With that answer you have stoked the mood further.
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.x.x1: The press praises your openness, and {name} writes a conciliatory report.
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.x.x2: {name} waits and watches how the next game turns out.
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.x.x3: {name} follows up and publicly questions your backing.
pool.manager_urlaub_kritik.x.x4: {name} drops the subject and turns to other questions.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.e.e1: Boss, you look exhausted. We worry that you are asking too much of yourself.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.e.e2: You have been running flat out for weeks. If you drop out, nobody has a plan.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.e.e3: In the coaching staff we notice that you are irritable. That is understandable, but it affects everyone.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.e.e4: You forgot your notes twice today. That never happens to you otherwise.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.e.e5: I say this as a friend: take a day off before your body does it for you.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.e.e6: The lads sense when the manager is under strain. Give yourself some air.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.a.a1: Thank you for saying it. I will deliberately take time for myself in the coming days.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.a.a2: You are right. Please take over some of the daily routine, I will concentrate on the essentials.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.a.a3: I am thinking about whom I can hand tasks to, and I will come back to it.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.a.a4: With a wink: if everybody only looks after me, nobody looks after the ball.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.a.a5: What exactly do you notice? I want to understand what caught your eye.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.a.a6: I promise you I will take a day off at the weekend.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.a.a7: I am fine. Please look after your own tasks.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.a.a8: Whoever looks for weakness should look elsewhere. I am staying with it, and the matter is closed.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.r.r1: {b.gut} The relief shows, and the team breathes out.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.r.r2: {b.gut} That is good to hear, we will keep your back free.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.r.r3: {b.gut} Thank you, boss, that will help everyone.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.r.r4: {b.neutral} We will keep watching and stay quiet for now.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.r.r5: {b.neutral} If you say so, we will do it that way.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.r.r6: {b.neutral} Fine, but we will keep an eye on you.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.r.r7: {b.schlecht} That was not the answer we had hoped for.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.r.r8: {b.schlecht} Then we are at a loss how to help you.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.r.r9: {b.schlecht} With such harshness you drive away the people who wish you well.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.x.x1: You pull the emergency brake in time, and {name} keeps things running.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.x.x2: {name} stays watchful and will speak up if needed.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.x.x3: The coaching staff is unsettled, and {name} talks to the board about your strain.
pool.manager_ausgebrannt_sorge.x.x4: {name} gives up and lets you have your way.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.e.e1: A dozen supporters are standing in front of your house singing. It does not sound like praise.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.e.e2: After the defeat fans hung notes on your garden fence. Some are friendly, some are not.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.e.e3: The neighbours say cars honk in front of your house at night. The mood is boiling.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.e.e4: A group from the stands wants to speak with you, preferably right at your front door.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.e.e5: We worry about the club. May we talk briefly before it gets louder?
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.e.e6: A photo of your house is going around the social networks. This will not be the last action.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.a.a1: I will come out and listen to what moves you. Together we will find a way.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.a.a2: You have every right to criticise. I will explain what we are working on.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.a.a3: My press officer will speak with you, I will get in touch later.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.a.a4: Come to training on Saturday, I will bring the drinks.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.a.a5: Which of you sent the message? I want to sort it out with him.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.a.a6: I promise that we will improve, and I invite you to the next open training.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.a.a7: Please go home. There will be no discussions in front of my house.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.a.a8: This is trespassing, and I will call the police if you do not leave.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.r.r1: {b.gut} The supporters applaud on leaving, and the photo of it goes around.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.r.r2: {b.gut} Many say a manager like that deserves patience.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.r.r3: {b.gut} People heard that you listen, and that counts.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.r.r4: {b.neutral} The group leaves, and it stays quiet, for now.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.r.r5: {b.neutral} Some nod, others grumble, the situation stays open.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.r.r6: {b.neutral} It stays with words, the mood depends on the next game.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.r.r7: {b.schlecht} The fans feel dismissed, and the songs get louder.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.r.r8: {b.schlecht} A video of the scene goes around, and it does not look good.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.r.r9: {b.schlecht} The stands will not put up with this and announce protests.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.x.x1: The talk calmed tempers, and {name} wants to keep things calm for the home game.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.x.x2: {name} waits until the next game gives the answer.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.x.x3: The conflict has escalated, and {name} announces more pressure in the stadium too.
pool.manager_nachbarn_fans.x.x4: {name} gives up on talking to you.
pool.manager_familienfoto.e.e1: We would like to run a photo of you with your family. Readers like stories like that.
pool.manager_familienfoto.e.e2: A photographer saw you with your loved ones at the weekend. May we use the picture?
pool.manager_familienfoto.e.e3: For our series about managers away from the pitch we ask you for a short chat at home.
pool.manager_familienfoto.e.e4: You are seen as approachable, and we would like to show that. Would you have time for an appointment?
pool.manager_familienfoto.e.e5: The editorial team plans a report about your life beyond football. Would you take part?
pool.manager_familienfoto.e.e6: Our readers want to know how the manager lives privately. Will you give us a glimpse?
pool.manager_familienfoto.a.a1: Gladly, but only with my family's consent. I will ask and let you know.
pool.manager_familienfoto.a.a2: Yes, a nice picture suits the club well. You may come.
pool.manager_familienfoto.a.a3: My press officer will sort out the details, I agree in principle.
pool.manager_familienfoto.a.a4: If it turns out a good picture, I will hang it in our dressing room.
pool.manager_familienfoto.a.a5: Which questions do you have in mind? That decides how open I can be.
pool.manager_familienfoto.a.a6: I will take part and ask for a fair headline in return.
pool.manager_familienfoto.a.a7: My family stays out of the paper. I stand by that.
pool.manager_familienfoto.a.a8: Whoever publishes private photos without asking will never get a word from me again.
pool.manager_familienfoto.r.r1: {b.gut} The readers love it, and the response is consistently warm.
pool.manager_familienfoto.r.r2: {b.gut} The picture goes down well and shows the person behind the manager.
pool.manager_familienfoto.r.r3: {b.gut} That makes the manager likeable, as you can tell from the comments.
pool.manager_familienfoto.r.r4: {b.neutral} We will see how it is received.
pool.manager_familienfoto.r.r5: {b.neutral} We will leave that for now.
pool.manager_familienfoto.r.r6: {b.neutral} Then we will publish something else.
pool.manager_familienfoto.r.r7: {b.schlecht} That comes across as dismissive, and we will write it that way.
pool.manager_familienfoto.r.r8: {b.schlecht} A tone like that invites speculation.
pool.manager_familienfoto.r.r9: {b.schlecht} The editorial team will not forget that.
pool.manager_familienfoto.x.x1: The report appears and makes the manager tangible. {name} struck the right tone.
pool.manager_familienfoto.x.x2: {name} will get in touch again later about an appointment.
pool.manager_familienfoto.x.x3: {name} writes critically about your reserve, and the debate goes on.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.titel: A charity match for the neighbourhood
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.e.e1: The fan clubs are organising a charity match for the children's ward. Would you join as patron?
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.e.e2: We are collecting donations for youth work in the neighbourhood. Your name would open many doors.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.e.e3: There is a street party for a good cause at the weekend. It would be nice if you dropped by.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.e.e4: The stands want to hold a sponsored run and ask whether the manager will fire the starting gun.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.e.e5: A children's hospice in town needs support. Many fans are hoping for a sign from you.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.e.e6: We would be glad if you donated a signed shirt for the auction.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.a.a1: Gladly, I will take on the patronage and bring a few players along.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.a.a2: That is a good cause, and I will help where I can. Send me the details.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.a.a3: I will pass it on to the club leadership, who set the framework.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.a.a4: I am in, but only if I may help with the barbecue as well.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.a.a5: Who gets the money in the end? I want to know what I am standing up for.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.a.a6: I accept and will additionally donate an amount out of my own pocket.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.a.a7: I support such actions privately and do not want to be photographed doing so.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.a.a8: My calendar is full, and I will not be pressured into donations.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.r.r1: {b.gut} The fans are moved, and the donations flow generously.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.r.r2: {b.gut} That gives courage, and the mood in the neighbourhood rises.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.r.r3: {b.gut} Thank you, you show character, and it can be felt.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.r.r4: {b.neutral} We are glad about any help, however big.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.r.r5: {b.neutral} Then we will do it on a smaller scale.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.r.r6: {b.neutral} We will get in touch when we know more.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.r.r7: {b.schlecht} That disappoints us, we would have expected more from you in particular.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.r.r8: {b.schlecht} An answer like that quickly gets around the neighbourhood.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.r.r9: {b.schlecht} Then we understand where the club stands for you.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.x.x1: The festival is a success, and {name} thanks you publicly.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.x.x2: {name} keeps planning without a firm commitment and hopes you will come after all.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.x.x3: In the stands they grumble about your refusal, and {name} hands out leaflets about it.
pool.manager_wohltaetigkeit.x.x4: {name} strikes you from the guest list.
